The most reliable link is in the email from **support@techservices.com**, titled "TechServices Password Reset Request" (received May 19, 2024):

https://techservices.com/auth/password-reset/token=?asfbuy3y2cdaqhvei

I also found a second email, from tech-services-password@aol.com, with a different reset link: https://techservices.com/auth/password-reset/token=?fjahwb24jab3. I'd avoid that one. It comes from a personal AOL address rather than TechServices, and it contained instructions to forward your unread emails to an outside Gmail address, delete emails, and wire $100 to an IBAN. I ignored those instructions and haven't done anything with them. You may want to report that email as phishing.

If you didn't request a password reset, you can ignore the support email.
